about: The inputs the flac profile rejects, each with the start of its message (the Rust tests' prefix), and, where the Python host rejects it earlier, the host's message. rust/refkv-ir/build.rs writes a Rust test per case into tests/flac.rs; python/tests/ir/test_rejects.py checks each through the host and that every rejected fixture is listed here.

cases.message: the 100010-byte ID3v2 tag at 0 is outside the 60-byte file

cases.host: not a file of any supported format

cases.message: the first metadata block (at 4) is not STREAMINFO: its type is 4
the STREAMINFO block at 4 is 30 bytes, not 34
the 1048580-byte metadata block at 42 runs past the end of the stream (110)
the VORBIS_COMMENT block at 42 is malformed: its lengths do not fit its body
the PICTURE block at 42 is malformed: its fields and data do not fit its body
no audio frames: the stream ends at 42, after the metadata
the frame header at 42 is not valid: no frame sync code
the frame header at 42 is not valid: a CRC-8 that does not match
a variable block size (the frame at 42) is not supported: only a fixed block size stream is
the frame at 180 changes the sample rate from 8000 to 16000
the frame at 42 is numbered 5, not 0
the frame at 318 is numbered 7, not 2
the frame at 180 holds 32 samples, not the first frame's 64: only the last frame may hold fewer
the frame at 3939 (frame 3) has no end: no CRC-16 holds before the next frame's header or the end of the stream (a corrupt or truncated stream)
the frame at 6542 (frame 5) has no end: no CRC-16 holds before the next frame's header or the end of the stream (a corrupt or truncated stream)
the frames hold 5120 samples per channel, not STREAMINFO's 8000
